p: Bitcoin steht bei 81.894 Dollar, +1,3 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -1,3 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.398 Dollar, +2,1 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,89 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,5 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 59 von 100.
32 Prozent der 301 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 34 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 32, also überverkauft.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 305,3 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 1,6 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 88,3 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (49,5 Milliarden Dollar), Base (6,2 Milliarden Dollar), BSC (5,9 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt L1 mit +98,4 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 54 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist SocialFi mit -11,5 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 110 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben CTSI (77), WIN (77), RENDER (75).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: BR +40,4 Prozent, AGT +40,3 Prozent, CARDS +26,9 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei CTSI: Über beiden Durchschnitten, RSI 50 im gesunden Bereich. Trend ohne Übertreibung.
Beim Social Buzz führen ZRO (89), STRK (82), Q (81).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: RPL (72), SPK (68), CAKE (69), SYRUP (67).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 2 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um +34 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 77.877 Blöcke. also rund 541 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 30 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 35 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

stimmung.herde_text: Die Herde ist zuversichtlich. Noch kein Extrem, aber neue Käufe brauchen jetzt gute Gründe und einen Plan für den Rücksetzer.
lage: Angst und Gier steht bei 59 (Greed): keine Extremlage.
Stablecoin-Umlauf +1,19 Mrd $ in 30 Tagen. Frisches Kapital im System.
Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 5,10 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: JPMorgan expands ‘JPM Coin’ deposit token to Ethereum for institutional clients
news.z: The USD-denominated deposit token now supports peer-to-peer transfers within the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem, including Base.

news.t: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
news.z: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

news.t: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
news.z: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.

news.t: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.z: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.t: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
news.z: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

news.t: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
news.z: World ID for Zoom is generally available after a beta that began in April, and is designed to spot deepfaked participants on Zoom calls.

news.t: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
news.z: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

news.t: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
news.z: HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.

news.t: Crypto.com, Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts; Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood hold off
news.z: Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Underdog, which also received cease-and-desist orders, have not filed suits in Missouri, according to court records.

news.t: MapQuest Now Shows Drivers Where Flock Cameras Are Watching
news.z: MapQuest’s app now offers an optional map layer that plots known license plate readers from Flock Safety and other vendors, as backlash against the cameras grows.

news.t: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints tokens and moves $727,000 to Ethereum
news.z: The attacker, after minting 10 million CYS, managed to bridge about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge and SWFT's Bridgers.

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs Shed Nearly $1 Billion in Two Weeks as Uptober Stays Red
news.z: Bitcoin ETFs lost a net $228.6 million this week, following a $681.1 million drain the week before and pushing October deep into the red.

news.t: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
news.z: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US ‌elections and sporting events.

news.t: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
news.z: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

news.t: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
news.z: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

news.t: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
news.z: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

news.t: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
news.z: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

news.t: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
news.z: Applied Optoelectronics told the WSJ it objected because it was unsure how tokenization would affect its stock price, liquidity and volatility.

news.t: Turkey confirms Hex founder Richard Heart’s arrest, says police seized $7.15 million and six cold wallets
news.z: Police reportedly seized $7.15 million in cash, six cold wallets, seven firearms and 1,400 rounds of ammunition in searches of 15 addresses.

news.t: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
news.z: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House race

news.t: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
news.z: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.

news.t: Chinese Startup StepFun Launches a Phone Built Around an AI Agent, Not Apps
news.z: StepFun's STEPX Neo opened for pre-orders in China on Oct. 13 at 3,999 yuan, with an AI agent built into the operating system instead of bolted on as an app.

news.z: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.
